name: Unmaking Mantle
description: Wear a mantle that unmakes the edge of each blow and the intent of each striker.

name: Essential Rend
description: Strike through the surface of a target to the one seam that holds it together and rend it.

name: Nullifying Aura
description: Hold an aura about the user that nullifies each technique as its first motion enters it.

name: Absolute Unbinding
description: Unmake every knot of a worked curse in an ally in turn until nothing of it is left.

name: Instance Annihilation
description: Annihilate the one instance of a body that stands before the user past any guard.

name: Collapse Verdict
description: Pass a verdict of collapse on every work of hand within a vast ring.

name: Dissolving Rain
description: Let a fine rain of unmaking fall across the field and strip each thing it touches.

name: Total Nullity
description: Draw down a total nullity over a wide circle that unmakes all cast techniques inside.

name: Ruin Throne
description: The school's seat of ruin whose guard and quell follow the qi the master gives it.

name: Sovereign Unmaking
description: The school's sovereign unmaking whose sweep follows the core given and falls on the works of the foe.

name: Great Ruin
description: Bring a great ruin down on a vast region up to the destructive ceiling of a Core-tier destruction master.

name: Erased Instance
description: Unmake one chosen object so fully that no trace of it remains; no cultivation mechanic explains how the world forgets it stood there.

name: Annihilating Mantle
description: Wear a mantle of annihilation that unmakes the force of every blow it meets.

name: Instance Rend
description: Rend the single instance of a ward or armour the user's hand finds and spare all others.

name: Annulling Presence
description: Stand as an annulling presence that unmakes each technique cast within arm's reach.

name: Final Unbinding
description: Unmake the whole body of a divine curse on an ally from its root to its last thread.

name: Divine Dissolution
description: Dissolve the form and the force of everything within a divine ring.

name: Nought Verdict
description: Pass a hollow verdict on a single foe and take the life in him past any ward.

name: Total Annulment
description: Annul every cast technique across a great field for as long as the annulment holds.

name: Dust Edict
description: Decree the dust of all works of hand within a vast circle and unmake their joins.

name: Ruin Sovereignty
description: The school's sovereignty of ruin whose reach follows the divine qi the master gives it.

name: Unmaking Crown
description: The school's crown of unmaking that falls on one target with a weight set by the core.

name: Dust Throne
description: The school's seat of dust that guards the master and unmakes the strength of those who near it.

name: Great Obliteration
description: Obliterate the works of a whole region up to the destructive ceiling of a divine destruction master.

name: Unmade Whole
description: Take a whole structure back to its parts and its parts to nothing; no cultivation mechanic explains where the unmade matter goes.

name: Absent Thing
description: Make one named thing absent from where it stands so that none of its effects remain; no cultivation mechanic explains the absence.
